messages.en: Don't think I'm angry. I'm just tired.
Oh, that explains it. I thought you were angry earlier. Get some rest. The work's done anyway.

senses.en_definition: A part of the body, especially a limb.
A member of a team, organisation or group, especially the police or armed forces.

messages.en: Your older brother's a police officer, right? Does he work at the station near our place?
Yeah, but he's stationed in Shah Alam. Not here.

senses.en_definition: Compressed air used to inflate tyres and other objects.
Gas in the digestive system, especially when released by burping or passing wind.
An unconfirmed report or rumour, chiefly in fixed expressions.
Mood or temper, especially when irritable or changeable.

messages.en: I'm just about to head out. Is it cold at the beach?
Pretty chilly, yeah. It's windy here. Bring a jacket too, or you'll end up shivering.
Have you watched that documentary about space yet?
Not yet. I'm planning to watch it tonight. Is it any good?
